findings.practical_consequence: A fresh planner cannot place every preserved duty into one exact directive, playbook, or operational contract without making new ownership decisions, so the promised one-shot rewrite and relocation plan is not yet mechanically derivable from the research.
evidence: Tasks/directive-system-vnext/research-v3/requirements.json FUT-004 requires every retained obligation to exist at one correct authority layer, and FUT-005 requires a complete exact replacement mapping.

Tasks/directive-system-vnext/research-v4/work/candidate-round-1.json complete_replacement_mapping assigns whole duty lists to composite owners such as "proposed G5/G6 plus research-plan-review boundary methods", "proposed G1/G2", "proposed G11 plus blocker-catalog remediation lane", and "proposed G9 plus working-agreement progress-cadence firing-timer procedure" instead of assigning each duty_id to one exact owner.

The same candidate's FUT-004 research_value claims each duty ID occurs once and complete_replacement_mapping is a one-owner map, but cardinality equality only proves each duty ID appears in one row; it does not resolve the multiple authority layers named inside that row.
